summary.candidate_gate: All five independent baseline manual/assessed/native gates pass. Root must record the full baseline source-binding gate before candidate launch. No candidate is reviewed or qualified here.

limits: Only closed samples with report, native audit and workflow replay are included. Raw failures remain failures.

Disposable production-written summary/facts files are captured before their temporary root is removed; hashes below bind capture snapshots and the recorded write acknowledgement, not surviving temporary files.
Forge, health, metering, rendering, publication and build continuation use the disclosed controlled dependencies. No hosted publication, actual build loop, run-close/andon or rendering-quality claim.
Production-generated summary annotations describe fixture state; wording about filed comments does not prove a live tracker write.

The exact-one normalisation restriction belongs to the retained original grader; the separately frozen amended assessment allows unused pre-publication drafts without changing final content, authority or native gates.
immutability: Final baseline supplement. Do not append candidates or rewrite this record after root binds its hash; candidate review needs a separate file.
